description:
Today's session on "Creating Safe Schools: A Teachers' Guide to POCSO" at M.L.R.T. Gala Pioneer English School was a resounding success.

It was heartening to see ninety staff members from both the English and Marathi sections participate with such enthusiasm and openness. Ms. Pratima Bhandarkar, our resource person, shared her wealth of knowledge with remarkable clarity and sensitivity, making the session highly interactive, engaging, and thought-provoking.

The "Myth or Fact" activity, where the ball was passed randomly for quick responses, kept everyone actively involved and reinforced key concepts in a lively manner. Equally encouraging was the willingness of the participants to share their own classroom experiences, enriching the discussions with practical insights.
